programs.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programs.desc: Andrew Zimmern begins another culinary adventure, during which he will again taste the strangest dishes in the world, from wild goat to duck liver.In the new season of the show, Andrew will taste snake eggs in Japan and drink snake bile in Shanghai.In Okinawa, people eat pickled pig's ear, poisonous urchin fish and tuna eye.Finally, he will go to China to try turtle, chicken hearts and snail shells.Viewers will find out whether Andrew will survive such a difficult test.

programs.desc: Two unknown people, a woman and a man, are left in a lonely place with difficult climatic conditions.They must spend 21 days there without food, water or clothing.They can only take one item with them.Operators show how people relying on their own company learn to cooperate and make key decisions together.Viewers will see that appropriate knowledge and skills can be very useful in extreme moments and even determine survival.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska goes to Prague, Czech Republic, where she plans to talk about... sex.The heroine of the episode is Vladana Augsten, a professional who treats sexuality through touch.She is a certified sexual assistant for disabled people, one of eleven in the Czech Republic.In Switzerland, Belgium, the Netherlands and Germany, this profession is widely known, but in this post-communist country it appeared for the first time only five years ago.Organizations training people involved in it also received funding from the state.One of them is the Freya Foundation.The sexuality of disabled people remains a taboo.Parents not only avoid the topic, but even make it difficult for their children to establish closer relationships, wanting to spare them pain and disappointment.The goal of Vladana and other sexual assistants is to support clients in their pursuit of independence.
